title: Q3 Secure-Edge Private Deployment Roadmap — Signal-Based Commitments & Acceptance Gates
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Objective: produce a sequenced, signal-driven quarterly roadmap that stabilizes SecureEdge private deployments (VPC + on-prem) for enterprise customers while providing clear acceptance gates and metricized OKR signals. This ticket captures the cross-functional commitments, measurement plan, rollout waves, and risk ledger for Q3. Focus areas: 1) Reliability SLOs for isolated tenants, 2) Upgrade & rollback runbooks, 3) Artifact-based acceptance gates (integration tests + infra smoke), 4) Customer enablement churn reduction and onboarding SLA targets.
okrs: OKR-1: Reduce private-deploy P95 latency tail by 20% vs baseline (target: 200ms reduction)
OKR-2: Decrease onboarding time for SecureEdge customers by 35% (target: <10 business days)
OKR-3: Zero P0 incidents caused by upgrade incompatibilities across waves
milestones: M1: Finalize signal taxonomy & acceptance gate checklist (by 2026-03-19)
M2: Integrations and e2e gating automation (by 2026-04-23)
M3: Pilot wave 1 for 5 lighthouse customers (by 2026-05-28)
M4: Expand wave 2 to 20 customers + GA readiness (by 2026-07-10)
acceptance_criteria: Automated acceptance pipeline passes for 95% of nightly compatibility tests against tenant images
Observability dashboards expose tenant-level SLOs + anomaly alerts
Runbook applied in a dry-run without manual escalations for two simulated upgrades
Customer onboarding playbook validated with at least one customer success-managed onboarding

2026-03-05: Draft signal taxonomy reviewed — removed redundant 'health-check-only' metric and added 'prefix-cache-hit-rate' as a reliability signal
2026-03-09: Design reviewed initial acceptance gate UI for console; DES feedback requested two additional state fields (rollback_reason, last_test_run)
2026-03-12: Security completed initial skim; KMS/HSM integration flagged as required for wave 2
decisions: Use three-tier wave approach (pilot, broaden, GA) for private deployments
Acceptance gates will be artifact-driven: nightly integration artifact + canary smoke run + infra health-checks
Prefix KV cache hit-rate will be promoted to primary reliability signal for the first two milestones
risks: Upstream kernel changes create performance regressions during wave expansion
Onboarding docs lag behind automation leading to manual work for CS
Third-party KMS integration delays block wave 2
Insufficient test coverage for heterogeneous on-prem environments
mitigation_tasks: Create 'invariant' performance tests that run on PRs touching kernel selection (ENG-4124)
Pair CS + PM for first two onboardings to iterate playbook and capture edge cases
Eng to provision a stubbed KMS that simulates HSM latencies for early testing
Add matrix of supported OS/container runtime combos to test farm and prioritize top-5 customer configs
